title: goal: Governed factory M3: evidence integrity
body:
**Kind:** goal

Source: `docs/designs/governed-factory.md` (milestone m3).

## Job

When the evidence a run leaves can only be trusted by the author, I want signed, attested bundles that anyone can verify offline, so I can show an outsider what the factory did.

## Outcome

- The evidence envelope and bundle writer exist; bundles are attested after post-merge success (M3-1, M3-2).
- Bundles verify with `gh attestation verify` and the offline `evidence verify` checker (M3-3, M3-4).
- Digests agree between Windows and WSL checkouts; prompt and context digests are recorded (M3-5, M3-6).
- ADRs 022 and 023 are written (M3-7, M3-8).
- `evidence verify` passes on a clean Windows machine and on WSL with no network and without the author's private keys; the five tamper fixtures fail with the reason named; the result is the same with the integration packages removed.

## Release intent

No publication beyond `next` prereleases cut by the author.

## Split judgment

Each work item in this milestone of the design is one focused PR with a declared scope; items that require each other stay one PR. The milestone's re-verification item (where it has one) lands first and fixes the exact file list. Shipping order follows the design's table.
